prompt_html: What would you do to add Volume as a column within a TWS Mosaic watch list?
choices_html: Configure the watch list using a right-click of the mouse, select Insert a Column and locate Volume from within the associated category.
Use the search window to locate Volume and follow any instructions returned in the search.
Locate and select Futures Volume from the blue New Window button in the upper left of Mosaic.
Drag a Volume column from another watch list.
